treatment_summary: The plan addresses hypertension, dyslipidaemia, high‑risk pre‑diabetes and obesity in line with NICE CG181/PH46/NG28. Ramipril and atorvastatin are started as first‑line agents; metformin is added pending renal function and HbA1c confirmation; semaglutide is offered for weight loss and additional cardiometabolic benefit. Monitoring of BP, lipids, renal function, liver enzymes, HbA1c and weight is scheduled per NICE recommendations, with annual medication review.
